import re

def slugify_v2(text):
    text = text.strip().lower()
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric with single hyphen, 
    # but strip leading/trailing hyphens from result
    result = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text)
    return result.strip("-")

# Test cases

print(f"'Hello World' -> {repr(slugify_v2('Hello World'))}")
